comment: Replace the positioning runtime with a standalone parity engine, browser regression coverage, an isolated comparative benchmark, and a 12,000-byte minified budget. Preserve virtual reference left/top coordinates when x/y are inconsistent. Detect whether size query containers form containing blocks (Chromium before 129). Measure the target three microtasks after clearing auto-size styles, like Floating UI, so observers of those writes can move it first. Isolate both size-container probe elements from page styles so fixed menus stay aligned, preserving geometry detection for older Chromium.
